title: Service binary runs from a temporary or user-writable folder
description: A service or systemd unit's executable sits in a location any user can write to. Real services live in system or program folders; attackers drop payloads in temp folders and register them as services to survive reboots.
benign_explanations: Per-user updaters (browsers, chat clients) sometimes register services under AppData
Developer tools started from a home directory during testing
